fact: Car 27 left the track and rejoined in the same position, whilst defending against Car 30
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio and in-car video evidence. Car 27 left the track at Turn 13 whilst defending against Car 30 into Turn 13, and by doing so, gained a lasting advantage over car 30 by maintaining the position. The driver rejoined the track in front of Car 30 and did not give the position back. The Stewards deemed Car 27 was "defending" its position. The Stewards determine that Car 27 gained a sporting advantage in position and that this advantage was not relinquished. Consistent with the Driving Standards Guidelines this is deemed to be a breach and the base line penalty of 10 seconds is applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 27 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
to: The Team Manager, Audi Revolut F1 Team
